svg.title: Textual Side and Visual Side Training Diagram
svg.desc: Complete editable SVG reconstruction. Base frames: f01 textual-side dashed rounded region; f02 visual-side dashed rounded region; f03 upper VA-Prompt/Image-Encoder dashed capsule; f04 lower VA-Prompt/Image-Encoder dashed capsule; f05 central ID-logits exchange strip. Textual side contains two rows D1 and D2 with label clusters, TA-Prompt, prompt stacks, text encoder stacks, text feature stacks, Fixed-T supervision, qT/qS markers, loss labels, update-gradient arrows, and quote captions. Visual side contains upper/lower rows with current image-feature stacks, EMA-T stacks, VA-Prompt towers, image encoders, image thumbnails, triplet/ID losses, each-layer arrows, update-gradient arrows, and pool/flame/snowflake annotations. Relationships follow left-to-right textual conduction and right/left interactive visual conduction with central logits links.
